chi_yuan_patrick_b_ryan_casey_ta_yixuan_: Chi Yuan, Patrick B Ryan, Casey Ta, Yixuan Guo, Ziran Li, Jill Hardin, Rupa Makadia, Peng Jin, Ning Shang, Tian Kang, et al. are the authors of the Criteria2Query system. They represent a multidisciplinary team of experts in medical informatics, data science, and clinical research, who collaborated to design and implement this innovative interface for clinical data querying.
